notes: Original Wowhead PTR cumulative Looter table row 1/6 for cloth armor, recorded from the 12.1.7 PTR item page. 199 disenchants are a single source-reported cumulative input cohort, NOT independent casts per row or a controlled player log. This 11.0.5 anniversary item displays mixed The War Within and Classic-era output families, potentially reflecting scaling/item-version effects. Output quality rank is not exposed; recurring Storm Dust rows are distinct UNLINKED source quality rows, not independent cohorts and must not be combined. Positive per-hit stack range is displayed, NOT a zero-inclusive histogram. Original collection date, build, bonus/version, skill, specialization, refunds and live eligibility unknown. Reference-only; do not promote to current TWW numeric baseline or gold EV.
